1.text: Umugabo wo mu muryango wa Lewi aragenda, arongora umukobwa wa Lewi.

2.text: Uwo mugore asama inda abyara umuhungu, maze abonye ko ari umwana mwiza, amuhisha amezi atatu.

3.text: Ananiwe guhora amuhisha, amubohera akato gapfundikiye mu ntamyi, agasiga ibumba n'ubushishi, ashyiramo uwo mwana, agashyira mu rufunzo rwo ku nkombe y'uruzi.

4.text: Mushiki we aramwitarura, ngo amenye ikiri bumubeho.

5.text: Umukobwa wa Farawo amanurwa no kwiyuhagira mu ruzi, abaja be bagendagenda ku nkombe y'uruzi, abona ka kato mu rufunzo atuma umuja we kukazana.

6.text: Agapfunduye abonamo uwo mwana, umwana ararira. Aramubabarira ati “Uyu ni umwana w'Abaheburayo.”

7.text: Mushiki we abaza umukobwa wa Farawo ati “Sinajya se kukuzanira umurera wo mu Baheburayokazi ngo amukurerere?”

8.text: Umukobwa wa Farawo aramusubiza ati “Nuko genda umunzanire.” Umukobwa aragenda, ahamagara nyina w'uwo mwana.

9.text: Umukobwa wa Farawo aramubwira ati “Jyana uyu mwana umunderere, nzaguhemba.” Uwo mugore ajyana uwo mwana, aramurera.

10.text: Umwana arakura, amushyira umukobwa wa Farawo, ahinduka umwana we. Amwita Mose ati “Ni uko namukuye mu mazi.”

11.text: Icyo gihe, Mose amaze gukura asanga bene wabo abona uburetwa barimo, bukeye abona Umunyegiputa akubita Umuheburayo muri bene wabo.

12.text: Akebaguza impande zose abona nta wuhari, yica uwo Munyegiputa amuhisha mu musenyi.

13.text: Bukeye bwaho arasohoka, abona abagabo babiri b'Abaheburayo barwana, abwira ugiriye undi nabi ati “Ni iki gitumye ukubita mugenzi wawe?”

14.text: Aramusubiza ati “Ni nde waguhaye ubutware n'ubucamanza kuri twe? Urashaka kunyica nk'uko wishe wa Munyegiputa?” Mose aratinya aribwira ati “Ni ukuri byaramenyekanye.”

15.text: Farawo abyumvise ashaka kwica Mose. Maze Mose aramuhunga ajya gutura mu gihugu cy'i Midiyani, agezeyo yicara iruhande rw'iriba.

16.text: Umutambyi w'i Midiyani yari afite abakobwa barindwi, baraza badahirira intama za se buzuza ibibumbiro.

17.text: Abashumba baraza barabirukana, Mose arahaguruka arabatabara, yuhira umukumbi wabo.

18.text: Bagiye kwa se Reweli arababaza ati “Noneho ko mutebutse?”

19.text: Baramusubiza bati “Ni uko umugabo w'Umunyegiputa yadukijije abashumba, kandi akatudahirira, akatwuhirira umukumbi.”

20.text: Abaza abakobwa be ati “Ari he? Ni iki gitumye musiga uwo mugabo? Nimumuhamagare, tumufungurire.”

21.text: Mose yemera kubana n'uwo mugabo, ashyingira Mose umukobwa we Zipora.

22.text: Abyara umuhungu, se amwita Gerushomu ati “Nari umusuhuke mu gihugu kitari icyacu.”

23.text: Hashize iminsi myinshi, umwami wa Egiputa aratanga. Abisirayeli banihishwa n'uburetwa babakoresha barataka, gutaka batakishwa n'uburetwa kurazamuka kugera ku Mana.

24.text: Imana yumva umuniho wabo, yibuka isezerano ryayo yasezeranye na Aburahamu na Isaka na Yakobo.

25.text: Imana ireba Abisirayeli, imenya uko bameze.
